Classification & limits

Each grade resolves to a limit per sample type — air / settle / contact / glove, alert and action.

GradeAir (CFU/m³)Settle plate (CFU/4h)Contact plate (CFU/plate)Glove print (CFU/glove)

Location type

Company → Site/Plant → Building/Facility → Suite/Line → Environmental Class/Grade → Sample Point ID. Grade is its own level, set directly under Suite/Line — a Room ID isn't tracked separately, so if two Grades belong to physically different rooms on the same line, that's only visible in each Grade's description text.
